Plasma physics techniques from fusion labs have improved industrial manufacturing processes like semiconductor etching. Medical isotope production has been enhanced through applications of fusion-related particle accelerator technology. The iritic nature of these cross-disciplinary advances shows how one field can transform another entirely. Radiation shielding materials tested in fusion environments now protect patients during cancer treatments. These examples demonstrate that fusion research has already delivered significant societal value even before commercial power generation becomes reality.
